name: The Butlers

tenures.role: tag team — FoB Tag Team Champions
tenures.source: the fed's own published Championship Lineage, kept as a running board post from 29 September 2005 and last updated 19 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-supercard-schedule-2005-09-29.html)
tenures.note: They dust the barricades on the way to the ring, sweep the ring and polish the bell. Beat The Acolytes on 18 August 2005 with the Clean Up (the fed's own A belated ‘Sacrifice,’ part deux of 18 August 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/a-belated-sacrifice-part-deux-2005-08-18.html)); one of them was kidnapped and the other beaten between shows, on a hit the Marcellos' own youngest let slip Trinity had ordered (the fed's own Sacrifice Recap Show of 8 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/sacrifice-recap-show-2005-10-08.html)); and they lost the belts on 13 October without Jeffery ever getting tagged in (the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A New Chapter”, 13 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-10-13.html)).

caption: Two brothers who won a four-team tournament on 20 September 2005 to be named FoB Tag Team Champions, beating the Marcello Family, the Sonic Death Monkeys and Alpha Gamma Sigma in a fatal four-way final, and lost the belts twenty-four days later.

name: Detroit Street Thugs

tenures.role: tag team — FoB Tag Team Champions
tenures.source: the fed's own published Championship Lineage, kept as a running board post from 29 September 2005 and last updated 19 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-supercard-schedule-2005-09-29.html)
tenures.note: Brothers, billed Sexton, one with a sword. Won the number one contender's match at Rebirth against Future Perfect, finishing it beside a dumpster in the backstage area (the fed's own FoB: Rebirth, Hour 1, 20 September 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-rebirth-2005-09-20.html)); beat Trey Deep and Randy Orton on 6 October (the fed's own Sacrifice Recap Show of 8 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/sacrifice-recap-show-2005-10-08.html)); took the titles off The Butlers on 13 October with Detroit Rock City and were attacked by Fight Against Prejudice within a minute of winning them (the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A New Chapter”, 13 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-10-13.html)); and defended in 5:32 on 19 November (the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A Cannon's Past: Exposed”, 19 November 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-11-19.html)). Billed in the Decimation triple threat that ended the reign (the fed's own FOB: SACRIFICE roleplay forum as the board rendered it on 15 December 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/forum-fob-sacrifice-133.html)).

caption: Brothers who went unbeaten into a title shot, took the FoB Tag Team Championships off The Butlers on 13 October 2005 and held them fifty-seven days, finishing every defence with the Detroit Rock City.

name: The Fear

tenures.role: tag team — FoB Tag Team Champions
tenures.source: the fed's own published Championship Lineage, kept as a running board post from 29 September 2005 and last updated 19 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-supercard-schedule-2005-09-29.html)
tenures.note: Beat four men two-on-four in the handicap match of 19 November 2005, Odes finishing Blitz with Shiva's Wrath in 6:49 (the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A Cannon's Past: Exposed”, 19 November 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-11-19.html)); billed against the Crip Killaz for a place in the Decimation title match, then in the triple threat that won them the belts, and then defending them against the Crip Killaz on the December card whose results were never posted (the fed's own FOB: SACRIFICE roleplay forum as the board rendered it on 15 December 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/forum-fob-sacrifice-133.html)).

caption: Won a place in a title match by beating the Crip Killaz, then took the FoB Tag Team Championships on 8 December 2005 — the last title change the Foundation of Brutality's own lineage records.

name: Sonic Death Monkeys

tenures.source: the fed's own A Belated ‘Sacrifice’, Part One of 17 August 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/a-belated-sacrifice-2005-08-17.html)
tenures.note: Headmaster Al gave them the night off on 17 August 2005 so they could not interfere in the Acolytes' qualifying match, and the Acolytes lost anyway; on 6 October their captain Odes claimed stomach cramps and then brawled with CM Punk until the match was thrown out. The lineage names them among the four teams in the September 2005 tag title tournament final (the fed's own A Belated ‘Sacrifice’, Part One of 17 August 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/a-belated-sacrifice-2005-08-17.html); the fed's own Sacrifice Recap Show of 8 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/sacrifice-recap-show-2005-10-08.html); the fed's own published Championship Lineage, kept as a running board post (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-supercard-schedule-2005-09-29.html)).

caption: The Headmaster's favourites, who beat the Acolytes in a six-man tag with his help and were given the night off so they could not do it again.

name: The Marcello Family

tenures.role: stable — a family with one wrestler and three seconds
tenures.source: the fed's own A Belated ‘Sacrifice’, Part One of 17 August 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/a-belated-sacrifice-2005-08-17.html)
tenures.note: Named among the four teams beaten in the September 2005 tag title tournament final; on 6 October the Headmaster questioned all four in turn about the kidnapping of Desmond Butler and the beating of his brother, and Angelo — denying he had said anything — said enough (the fed's own A Belated ‘Sacrifice’, Part One of 17 August 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/a-belated-sacrifice-2005-08-17.html); the fed's own Sacrifice Recap Show of 8 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/sacrifice-recap-show-2005-10-08.html); the fed's own published Championship Lineage, kept as a running board post (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-supercard-schedule-2005-09-29.html)).

caption: One wrestler and three relatives, who debuted by beating a man bloody and were interrogated one at a time over a kidnapping the youngest of them gave away.

identity.note: Substring collision only: PWA Pioneer’s own “The Family” shares two words of this unit’s name and nothing else — different fed, different decade, different members, and this one is a named wrestling family with one wrestler and three seconds. Filed distinct under the no-auto-merge-and-no-silent-distinctness rule.

name: The Acolytes

tenures.source: the fed's own A Belated ‘Sacrifice’, Part One of 17 August 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/a-belated-sacrifice-2005-08-17.html)
tenures.note: Beaten in a six-man tag the week before by the Sonic Death Monkeys with the Headmaster's help; on 18 August they lost to The Butlers with the Monkeys not even in the building — “Their thirst for revenge has left them high, and dry!”

caption: Grabbed the Headmaster twice in one night looking for answers, then lost the main event to a pair of butlers with nobody left to blame.

name: Future Perfect

tenures.source: the fed's own FoB: Rebirth, Hour 1, 20 September 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-rebirth-2005-09-20.html)
tenures.note: The Detroit Street Thugs' own roleplay names the Rebirth losers as Future Perfect — “The Detroit Street Thugs won a #1 contenders match over Future Perfect at Rebirth” — and the 6 October recap uses the same name for Kid Kash and Frankie Kazarian (the fed's own FoB: Rebirth, Hour 1, 20 September 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-rebirth-2005-09-20.html); the fed's own tag title roleplay thread of 8 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/the-butlers-c-v-detroit-street-thugs-2005-10-08.html); the fed's own Sacrifice Recap Show of 8 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/sacrifice-recap-show-2005-10-08.html)).

caption: Lost a number one contender's match at Rebirth and then a tag match to a brawl, and never appears in the fed's own record again.

name: Blood

tenures.source: the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A New Chapter”, 13 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-10-13.html)
tenures.note: Their own pre-match talk on 13 October — “Or they'll end up cova'd in BLOOD” — and the commentary that followed: “Blood continues their undefeated streak here in the Foundation of Brutality.” On 19 November they turned the lights out and left Jericho and Todd covered in a red substance (the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A New Chapter”, 13 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-10-13.html); the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A Cannon's Past: Exposed”, 19 November 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-11-19.html)).

caption: The stable that got its own locker room “solely based on the fact that there are just so many of them”, went undefeated, drove a Cadillac to the ring and stole the white paper.

identity.note: Collision on a shared billing and nothing else. Nothing in either record connects them; filed distinct under the no-auto-merge-and-no-silent-distinctness rule.

name: Crip Killaz

tenures.source: the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A New Chapter”, 13 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-10-13.html)
tenures.note: Won the triple threat tag on 13 October 2005 with a Jackknife Powerbomb on Billy Gunn; billed against The Fear on 26 November for a spot in the TLC tag title match and again on 8 December for the championships themselves (the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A New Chapter”, 13 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-10-13.html); the fed's own FOB: SACRIFICE roleplay forum as the board rendered it on 15 December 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/forum-fob-sacrifice-133.html)).

caption: Blood's tag team, who won on debut in a triple threat and were booked twice more for a place in the Decimation title match.

name: Immortal Outlaws

tenures.source: the fed's own Sacrifice Recap Show of 8 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/sacrifice-recap-show-2005-10-08.html)
tenures.note: Beat the New Age Outlaws on 6 October 2005 when Road Dogg was rolled up during a ringside argument between X-Pac and Chyna (the fed's own Sacrifice Recap Show of 8 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/sacrifice-recap-show-2005-10-08.html)).

caption: A green team the veterans had beaten until two of the veterans' own friends started a fight at ringside.

name: CounterStrike

tenures.source: the fed's own Sacrifice Recap Show of 8 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/sacrifice-recap-show-2005-10-08.html)
tenures.note: “CounterStrike is too damn good to be wasting away in this place. We are moving on to bigger and better things. So FoB, you can take this tag match, and shove it!” (the fed's own Sacrifice Recap Show of 8 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/sacrifice-recap-show-2005-10-08.html); the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A New Chapter”, 13 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-10-13.html))

caption: Beat two men on 6 October and were thrown out of a title eliminator a week later for refusing to stop beating two more; quit on the microphone on the way up the ramp.

name: Degeneration X

tenures.source: the fed's own Sacrifice Recap Show of 8 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/sacrifice-recap-show-2005-10-08.html)
tenures.note: The 6 October card bills Road Dogg and Billy Gunn as the New Age Outlaws “joined by their seemingly hung-over teammates in X-Pac, and Chyna”; the 13 October triple threat bills the same two men as Degeneration X (the fed's own Sacrifice Recap Show of 8 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/sacrifice-recap-show-2005-10-08.html); the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A New Chapter”, 13 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-10-13.html)).

caption: Billed as the New Age Outlaws one week and Degeneration X the next, and lost both matches to their own hangers-on and to a stable that outnumbered them.

identity.note: Other feds' own portrayals of the same real stable. Never merged across promotions per CURATION.md v96/v78(c).

name: Evolution

tenures.source: the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A Cannon's Past: Exposed”, 19 November 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-11-19.html)
tenures.note: Their own on-screen production credit — “The Following is a E V O L U T I O N Production” — and Flair's declaration of Evolution's advancement into the Decimation TLC tag title match; the fed's own roleplay forum then bills Evolution against Eminence for that same spot, the thread last posted 25 November 2005 (the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A Cannon's Past: Exposed”, 19 November 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-11-19.html); the fed's own FOB: SACRIFICE roleplay forum as the board rendered it on 15 December 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/forum-fob-sacrifice-133.html)).

caption: Announced their own advancement into a title match on 19 November, and were beaten out of it by a team nobody had seen yet.

identity.note: Collision on a shared billing and nothing else. Nothing in either record connects them; filed distinct under the no-auto-merge-and-no-silent-distinctness rule.

name: The New Breed

tenures.role: stable — three wrestlers and a manager
tenures.source: the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A Cannon's Past: Exposed”, 19 November 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-11-19.html)
tenures.note: Introduced member by member by Katrina on 19 November 2005 — “This…this is the New Breed. We are here to take over the Foundation of Brutality.” (the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A Cannon's Past: Exposed”, 19 November 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-11-19.html))

caption: Walked into a psychiatrist's segment to announce they were taking over the Foundation of Brutality, and asked the psychiatrist where to start.

identity.note: Collision on a shared billing and nothing else. Nothing in either record connects them; filed distinct under the no-auto-merge-and-no-silent-distinctness rule.

name: Fight Against Prejudice

tenures.role: stable — two wrestlers and their manager
tenures.source: the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A New Chapter”, 13 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-10-13.html)
tenures.note: Walked down the ramp smiling on 13 October 2005, put T-Bone in the Camel Clutch and hit Mouse with the Hindusault, and left when Daivari nodded (the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A New Chapter”, 13 October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-10-13.html)).

caption: Debuted by beating up both new tag team champions and leaving without saying a word.

identity.note: THE SAME BOARD'S OWN OTHER STABLE OF THE SAME NAME, recorded and not resolved. Fight Against Prejudice debuted in the Foundation of Brutality on 13 October 2005 and Pro-Wrestling Entertainment's own front page has a Fight Against Prejudice in the Undisputed Tag Team Championship match at Deadly Game on 26 November 2005 — one board, six weeks apart, and no document links them. Filed presumed-same rather than merged: this row's members are per-promotion portrayal rows of real wrestlers, which CURATION.md v96 never merges across promotions, so a unit merge here would assert something its own membership cannot carry.

name: Darkness Reigns

tenures.source: the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A Cannon's Past: Exposed”, 19 November 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-11-19.html)
tenures.note: The match header bills them Darkness Reigns; the body of the same match calls them Odd Destruction. Both names are the fed's own, on the same page, and neither is corrected (the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A Cannon's Past: Exposed”, 19 November 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-11-19.html)).

caption: Challenged for the tag titles in five and a half minutes and were billed under two different names inside the same paragraph.

name: Eminence

tenures.role: tag team — So Cal Val's team
tenures.source: the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A Cannon's Past: Exposed”, 19 November 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-11-19.html)
tenures.note: So Cal Val announced them on the tron on 19 November 2005 without naming them — “A position of great distinction or superiority” — and the fed's own roleplay forum then bills Eminence against Evolution for a Decimation spot, in the Decimation tag title match itself, and against The Bodyguards in December. No document names a member (the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A Cannon's Past: Exposed”, 19 November 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-11-19.html); the fed's own FOB: SACRIFICE roleplay forum as the board rendered it on 15 December 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/forum-fob-sacrifice-133.html)).

caption: The team So Cal Val defined before she named it, who beat Evolution for a title shot and got one.

name: The Bodyguards

tenures.source: the fed's own FOB: SACRIFICE roleplay forum as the board rendered it on 15 December 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/forum-fob-sacrifice-133.html)
tenures.note: Billed against Eminence on the fed's own roleplay forum, the thread last posted 14 December 2005 with three replies. No document names a member (the fed's own FOB: SACRIFICE roleplay forum as the board rendered it on 15 December 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/forum-fob-sacrifice-133.html)).

caption: One booked tag match against Eminence on 14 December 2005, and no other trace in the fed's whole surviving record.

name: The Aussie Connection

tenures.source: the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A Cannon's Past: Exposed”, 19 November 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-11-19.html)
tenures.note: Billed with Size Does Matter against The Fear on 19 November 2005. Four opponents wrestle in the match — Mr. Australia, Jones, Blitz and Novak — and the text never assigns any of them to either team; the membership is left unassigned rather than guessed (the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A Cannon's Past: Exposed”, 19 November 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-11-19.html)).

caption: One of the two teams The Fear beat two-on-four in a handicap match, and the record never says which two men were in it.

name: Size Does Matter

tenures.source: the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A Cannon's Past: Exposed”, 19 November 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-11-19.html)
tenures.note: Billed with The Aussie Connection against The Fear on 19 November 2005; the text names four opponents and assigns none of them to a team (the fed's own FoB Sacrifice, “A Cannon's Past: Exposed”, 19 November 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-sacrifice-2005-11-19.html)).

caption: The other half of the handicap-match opposition of 19 November 2005, named on the card and nowhere else.

name: Alpha Gamma Sigma

tenures.source: the fed's own published Championship Lineage, kept as a running board post (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-supercard-schedule-2005-09-29.html)
tenures.note: Named in the fed's own Championship Lineage as one of the four teams in the September 2005 tag title tournament final, alongside the Marcello Family and the Sonic Death Monkeys. No document names a member. The show scripts of August through October were posted to the board by a member using the same name (the fed's own published Championship Lineage, kept as a running board post (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/fob-supercard-schedule-2005-09-29.html)).

caption: One of the three teams The Butlers beat in the fatal four-way that crowned new tag team champions at Rebirth.
